bad_request.title: Bad request
bad_request.detail: The request is invalid. Check the data and try again.

malformed_json.title: Malformed JSON
malformed_json.detail: The request body is not valid JSON.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.detail: The requested resource or route was not found.

method_not_allowed.title: Method not allowed
method_not_allowed.detail: This route does not support the requested method.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.detail: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

payload_too_large.title: Payload too large
payload_too_large.detail: The request body exceeds the allowed size.

unsupported_media_type.title: Unsupported media type
unsupported_media_type.detail: The request content type is not supported.

too_many_requests.title: Too many requests
too_many_requests.detail: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

error.title: Request failed
error.detail: The request could not be completed.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.detail: You do not have permission to perform this action.

wrong_audience.title: Wrong token audience
wrong_audience.detail: This token cannot be used on this part of the API.

scope_unavailable.title: Scope unavailable
scope_unavailable.detail: The token has no scope for the requested organisation, building, unit or lease.

invalid_credentials.title: Sign-in failed
invalid_credentials.detail: The email, password or code is not correct.

account_locked.title: Account temporarily locked
account_locked.detail: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.

account_disabled.title: Account disabled
account_disabled.detail: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.

otp_invalid.title: Incorrect code
otp_invalid.detail: The code is not correct. Check the SMS and try again.

otp_expired.title: Code expired
otp_expired.detail: This code has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

otp_attempts_exceeded.title: Too many wrong codes
otp_attempts_exceeded.detail: Too many wrong codes for this request. Request a new code.

otp_rate_limited.title: Please wait before requesting another code
otp_rate_limited.detail: A code was sent recently. Wait before requesting another one.

totp_required.title: Authenticator code required
totp_required.detail: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

totp_invalid.title: Incorrect authenticator code
totp_invalid.detail: The authenticator code is not correct.

totp_enrollment_required.title: Set up two-factor authentication
totp_enrollment_required.detail: Platform accounts must enrol an authenticator app before signing in. Use the enrolment token.

refresh_invalid.title: Session expired
refresh_invalid.detail: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

refresh_reused.title: Session ended for security
refresh_reused.detail: This refresh token was already used; every session of this sign-in was ended. Please sign in again.

line_token_invalid.title: LINE sign-in failed
line_token_invalid.detail: The LINE token could not be verified. Open the app from LINE again.

no_access.title: No access
no_access.detail: This account has no access to this part of getproperty yet.

identity_token_invalid.title: Sign-in failed
identity_token_invalid.detail: The Google or Apple sign-in could not be verified. Try again.

identity_email_in_use.title: E-mail already has an account
identity_email_in_use.detail: This e-mail already belongs to a getproperty account. Sign in the way you did before, then add Google or Apple in your profile.

identity_contact_required.title: Phone or e-mail needed
identity_contact_required.detail: This sign-in did not share an e-mail address. Sign up with your phone number instead.

identity_not_linked.title: Not linked to an account
identity_not_linked.detail: This sign-in is not linked to a getproperty account yet. Sign in with your phone number, then add it in your profile.

identity_in_use.title: Linked to another account
identity_in_use.detail: This sign-in already belongs to another getproperty account. Sign in with it there, or remove it from that account first.

identity_locked.title: Cannot be removed here
identity_locked.detail: LINE and your phone number carry your notifications and links to your leases, so they stay on the account.

identity_last.title: Keep one way to sign in
identity_last.detail: This is your only way to sign in. Add your phone number or another sign-in first.

failed.title: Validation failed
failed.detail: Some fields are invalid. See errors for details.

context_required.title: Organisation required
context_required.detail: Choose the organisation with the X-Tenant-Id header.

not_in_scope.title: Organisation not accessible
not_in_scope.detail: Your account has no access to this organisation.

read_only.title: Tenant is read-only
read_only.detail: The subscription is suspended: data can be viewed and exported but not changed (D-082).

key_required.title: Idempotency-Key required
key_required.detail: This operation requires an Idempotency-Key header (uuid).

key_reused.title: Idempotency-Key reused
key_reused.detail: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

in_progress.title: Request in progress
in_progress.detail: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry shortly.

stale.title: Resource changed
stale.detail: The resource was modified by someone else. Reload and try again.

precondition_required.title: If-Match required
precondition_required.detail: Send the If-Match header with the ETag of the resource.

tariff_cap.title: Bill line above the utility tariff cap
tariff_cap.detail: The price per unit is above the utility's tariff; the bill cannot be issued (D-021).

deposit_cap.title: Deposit above the legal cap
deposit_cap.detail: Security deposit plus advance rent exceed the cap of the residential rental announcement (D-023).

bill_immutable.title: Bill already issued
bill_immutable.detail: An issued bill cannot be changed; issue a credit or debit note instead (D-040).

no_power_cutoff.title: Power cut-off not allowed
no_power_cutoff.detail: The platform never cuts power or access for arrears (D-024).

acknowledgement_required.title: Acknowledgement required
acknowledgement_required.detail: The value exceeds a legal reference. Read the warning and acknowledge it to continue.

forbidden_clause.title: Forbidden clause
forbidden_clause.detail: This addendum clause is of a type the announcement forbids.

no_renewal_fee.title: No renewal fee
no_renewal_fee.detail: A renewal fee may not be charged to an existing lessee.

no_midterm_increase.title: No mid-term increase
no_midterm_increase.detail: Rent and service charges cannot change during the term unless agreed at signing.

notice_period.title: Notice period too short
notice_period.detail: A lessee's notice must be given at least 30 days in advance.

termination_notice.title: Lessor termination not compliant
termination_notice.detail: A lessor termination needs a contractual ground, written notice and 30 days to remedy (7 days when others are affected).

bill_disclosure.title: Units and rates must be shown
bill_disclosure.detail: Electricity and water are billed by units used at a per-unit rate, never as a fixed charge.

water_minimum.title: Water minimum above the utility's
water_minimum.detail: A water minimum charge may not exceed the utility's own minimum charge.

late_fee_policy.title: Late fees not enabled
late_fee_policy.detail: Late fees are allowed only when enabled and proportionate per the contract.

deposit_wear.title: Normal wear cannot be deducted
deposit_wear.detail: Normal wear and tear may not be deducted from the deposit.

deposit_evidence.title: Evidence required
deposit_evidence.detail: A deposit deduction needs a damage item with evidence (photos).

deposit_deadline.title: Deposit refund overdue
deposit_deadline.detail: The deposit must be refunded within 7 days of the lease end and hand-back.

no_forfeiture.title: No forfeiture
no_forfeiture.detail: The deposit or advance rent may not be forfeited without a breach by the lessee.

scope.title: In scope of the announcement
scope.detail: Tenants renting out 3 or more units are subject to the OCPB 2568 announcement.

invoice_lead_time.title: Due date too early
invoice_lead_time.detail: The invoice must reach the lessee at least 3 days before its due date.

entry_notice.title: Notice required before entry
entry_notice.detail: Entering a unit requires prior notice except in an emergency.

no_cutoff.title: No cut-off or lock-out
no_cutoff.detail: Cutting power or water, locking out or removing belongings for arrears is not allowed; the platform has no such function.

invoice_immutable.title: Issued invoices are immutable
invoice_immutable.detail: An issued invoice cannot be changed or deleted; issue a credit/debit note or void and re-issue it.

invalid_payload.title: Invalid device payload
invalid_payload.detail: The gateway payload does not match the device protocol.

provisioning_code_invalid.title: Invalid provisioning code
provisioning_code_invalid.detail: The provisioning code is wrong, expired or already used.

csr_invalid.title: Invalid certificate request
csr_invalid.detail: The certificate signing request is not valid for this gateway.

invalid_state.title: Device cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The device is not in a state that allows this action.

certificate_invalid.title: Invalid device certificate
certificate_invalid.detail: The gateway certificate is unknown, revoked, expired or belongs to another device.

not_gateway.title: Not a gateway
not_gateway.detail: This device is not a gateway.

in_use.title: Device in use
in_use.detail: The device still has meters bound to it; unbind or swap them first.

unavailable.title: Device unavailable
unavailable.detail: The device is not active in this building.

unavailable.title: Provider unavailable
unavailable.detail: A third-party provider is unavailable. Please try again later.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.detail: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

unexpected.title: Unexpected error
unexpected.detail: Something went wrong on our side. The request id helps us find it.

not_found.title: Invitation not found
not_found.detail: The invitation code is not valid.

not_pending.title: Invitation no longer valid
not_pending.detail: This invitation was already used, revoked or has expired.

party_mismatch.title: Invitation already used
party_mismatch.detail: This invitation belongs to another account, or the party is linked to another login.

last_owner.title: The last owner cannot leave
last_owner.detail: A tenant must keep at least one active owner.

already_member.title: Already a member
already_member.detail: This person is already a member of the tenant.

grant_required.title: Support grant required
grant_required.detail: Support staff need an active, time-boxed support grant approved for this tenant.

invalid_transition.title: Support grant cannot change
invalid_transition.detail: The support grant is not in a state that allows this action.

read_only.title: Read-only support access
read_only.detail: A support grant allows reading the tenant's data only; changes need the tenant or a platform admin.

invalid_state.title: Bank account cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The bank account is not waiting for OTP confirmation.

owner_phone_missing.title: Owner phone required
owner_phone_missing.detail: Add a verified phone number to your account to confirm bank account changes by OTP.

not_editable.title: Setting not editable here
not_editable.detail: This setting cannot be changed at this scope or by this role.

invalid_value.title: Invalid setting value
invalid_value.detail: The value does not match the type of the setting.

backdated.title: Settings cannot be backdated
backdated.detail: A new value takes effect now or in the future, never in the past (ADR-0004).

not_found.title: No published utility tariff
not_found.detail: No verified and published utility tariff is in force on that date.

invalid_state.title: Tariff version cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The tariff version is not in a state that allows this action.

same_verifier.title: A second person must verify
same_verifier.detail: The person who entered a tariff version cannot verify it (maker-checker).

invalid_structure.title: Invalid tariff structure
invalid_structure.detail: The tariff structure is not valid.

invalid_transition.title: Action not allowed in this state
invalid_transition.detail: This action is not allowed in the current state.

guard_failed.title: Action conditions not met
guard_failed.detail: The conditions for this action are not met yet.

not_uploaded.title: File not uploaded yet
not_uploaded.detail: The file has not been uploaded to storage yet.

size_mismatch.title: File does not match
size_mismatch.detail: The uploaded file does not match the declared size or checksum.

scan_pending.title: File is being checked
scan_pending.detail: The file is still being scanned for viruses. Try again shortly.

infected.title: File blocked
infected.detail: The file failed the virus scan and cannot be downloaded.

type_not_allowed.title: File type not allowed
type_not_allowed.detail: This file type is not allowed for this kind of document.

not_allowed.title: Grant not allowed
not_allowed.detail: Only the owner or operator tenant of a building can grant access to it.

unknown_purpose.title: Unknown consent purpose
unknown_purpose.detail: The consent purpose or version does not exist.

required.title: Consent required
required.detail: Read and accept the privacy consents before continuing.

not_replayable.title: Cannot replay
not_replayable.detail: Only failed or dead messages can be replayed.

template_invalid.title: Template cannot be rendered
template_invalid.detail: The template does not compile or render with its sample data.

cursor_invalid.title: Invalid cursor
cursor_invalid.detail: The cursor is malformed or expired.

token_invalid.title: Realtime token invalid
token_invalid.detail: The realtime token is invalid or expired.

duplicate.title: Already exists
duplicate.detail: A record with this key already exists (e.g. unit number, floor level or code).

read_only.title: Read-only access
read_only.detail: You see this building or unit through a grant; only its owner or operator can change it.

invalid_status_transition.title: Status change not allowed
invalid_status_transition.detail: Only vacant ↔ inactive or maintenance can be set manually; other statuses follow leases and service work.

already_assigned.title: Meter already assigned
already_assigned.detail: The unit already has an active meter for this utility, or the meter code is taken.

channel_exists.title: Channel already bound
channel_exists.detail: The meter or the bus address is already bound to a gateway.

no_channel.title: Meter not bound
no_channel.detail: The meter is not bound to a gateway.

file_invalid.title: Invalid import file
file_invalid.detail: The Excel file could not be read; use the template downloaded from getproperty.

invalid_rows.title: Some rows are invalid
invalid_rows.detail: Fix the rows with errors and preview again before importing.

preview_stale.title: Preview out of date
preview_stale.detail: The building or the file changed since the preview; preview again.

link_not_active.title: Link not active
link_not_active.detail: This login is not linked to the party any more.

link_request_not_pending.title: Link request already decided
link_request_not_pending.detail: This link request was already confirmed or rejected.

invalid_state.title: Not allowed in this lease state
invalid_state.detail: This action is not allowed in the lease's current state.

overlap.title: Overlapping lease
overlap.detail: The term overlaps another lease in force on this unit.

unit_unavailable.title: Unit not available
unit_unavailable.detail: The unit is inactive or under maintenance.

lessee_identity_missing.title: Lessee identity missing
lessee_identity_missing.detail: Record the lessee's ID document type and number before sending for signature.

contract_changed.title: Contract changed
contract_changed.detail: The contract you viewed is not the current one; open it again before signing.

not_signer.title: Not a signer
not_signer.detail: This account is not linked to a signer of this lease.

already_signed.title: Already signed
already_signed.detail: This signer has already signed the lease.

signatures_missing.title: Signatures missing
signatures_missing.detail: Every lessee signer must sign before the lessor countersigns.

signature_invalid.title: Invalid signature image
signature_invalid.detail: The signature must be a PNG image of at most 200 KB.

stamp_duty_not_fixed.title: Stamp duty not fixed yet
stamp_duty_not_fixed.detail: The stamp duty is computed when the lease is sent for signature. Send the lease first, then record the payment.

stamp_duty_paid.title: Stamp duty already paid
stamp_duty_paid.detail: A stamp duty payment is already recorded on this lease.

e_stamp_unavailable.title: e-Stamp payment is not available
e_stamp_unavailable.detail: e-Stamp is not connected or the lease is not signed by both parties yet. Pay at the Revenue Department and record the payment with the receipt instead.

notice_nothing_overdue.title: Nothing is overdue
notice_nothing_overdue.detail: This lease has no overdue invoice, so there is nothing to put in a late-payment notice.

invalid_state.title: Not possible in this deposit state
invalid_state.detail: The deposit or its settlement is not in a state that allows this action ({status}).

refund_mismatch.title: Refund does not match the settlement
refund_mismatch.detail: The refund must pay back at least the proposed (or agreed) amount: only itemised deductions with evidence may be kept.

item_required.title: A deposit deduction must point at a move-out report item
item_required.detail: Choose the move-out report item with its photos, so the resident sees the evidence beside the move-in report.

invalid_state.title: Not possible in this inspection state
invalid_state.detail: The inspection is not in a state that allows this action ({status}).

exists.title: Inspection already exists
exists.detail: This lease already has an inspection of this type.

non_monotonic.title: Register went backwards
non_monotonic.detail: The register is lower than the previous accepted reading and is not a rollover; review it or record a meter swap.

photo_required.title: Photo required
photo_required.detail: A photo of the meter is required for this reading.

duplicate.title: Reading already recorded
duplicate.detail: A reading for this meter at this time already exists.

review_closed.title: Review already decided
review_closed.detail: This reading review has already been decided.

no_assignment.title: Meter not assigned
no_assignment.detail: The meter has no active assignment at that time.

unreadable.title: Reading unreadable
unreadable.detail: The register could not be read from the photo; enter it manually.

signature_invalid.title: Invalid signature
signature_invalid.detail: The release manifest signature does not verify against a trusted key.

release_exists.title: Release exists
release_exists.detail: A release with this version and architecture already exists.

artifact_missing.title: Release artefact missing
artifact_missing.detail: The release artefact is not in the releases bucket with the manifest's size; upload it first.

ring_order.title: Ring order
ring_order.detail: The previous ring must complete before this ring starts.

invalid_transition.title: Invalid rollout transition
invalid_transition.detail: The rollout cannot move to that state from its current state.

not_allowed.title: Command not allowed
not_allowed.detail: You may not send this command to this device.

not_replayable.title: Not replayable
not_replayable.detail: This dead letter cannot be replayed.

duplicate.title: Invoice exists
duplicate.detail: An invoice for this utility and period already exists.

unreadable.title: E-bill unreadable
unreadable.detail: Some fields could not be read from the e-bill; enter the invoice manually.

no_invoice.title: No utility invoice
no_invoice.detail: Enter the utility invoice for this period first.

invalid_state.title: Invoice in the wrong state
invalid_state.detail: The invoice is not in a state that allows this action

not_ready.title: Invoice not ready to issue
not_ready.detail: The invoice still has items to review (such as a missing reading) and cannot be issued yet

has_payments.title: Invoice has payments
has_payments.detail: An invoice with payments cannot be voided; issue a credit note instead

credit_exceeds.title: Credit exceeds the invoice
credit_exceeds.detail: The credit note exceeds the line amount or the invoice's outstanding balance

backdated.title: Rate cannot be backdated
backdated.detail: A new rate must take effect today or later and never inside a billed period

version_in_force.title: Rate version in force
version_in_force.detail: A rate version already in force cannot be changed; save a new version

in_use.title: Rate plan in use
in_use.detail: A rate plan used by leases or invoices cannot be deleted

invalid_state.title: Billing cycle in the wrong state
invalid_state.detail: The billing cycle is not in a state that allows this action

not_ready.title: Export not ready
not_ready.detail: The export file is still being built, or building it failed

partial_not_allowed.title: Partial payment not accepted
partial_not_allowed.detail: Partial payments are off for this landlord; the amount must equal what is due

invalid_state.title: Payment in the wrong state
invalid_state.detail: The payment is not in a state that allows this action

credit_used.title: Credit already used
credit_used.detail: The credit this payment created was used or refunded; reverse those first

unavailable.title: QR payment unavailable
unavailable.detail: The landlord has no QR payment provider; transfer to the account and upload the slip

not_allowed.title: Slips not accepted
not_allowed.detail: The landlord does not accept transfer slips

invalid_state.title: Slip in the wrong state
invalid_state.detail: This slip was already decided, or the same transfer was already used by an earlier slip (reject that one first)

exceeds_credit.title: Refund exceeds the credit
exceeds_credit.detail: The refund is larger than the payer's remaining credit

signature_invalid.title: Invalid signature
signature_invalid.detail: The callback signature is invalid or the merchant is unknown

malformed.title: Malformed callback
malformed.detail: The callback body could not be read

duplicate.title: Settlement already processed
duplicate.detail: A settlement file of this account and date was already processed

unreadable.title: Settlement file unreadable
unreadable.detail: The settlement file could not be read

exists.title: Subscription exists
exists.detail: The tenant already has an open subscription; change its plan instead.

not_found.title: No subscription
not_found.detail: The tenant has no open subscription.

invalid_state.title: Not possible in this state
invalid_state.detail: The subscription cannot do this in its current state.

plan_mismatch.title: Plan not for this tenant type
plan_mismatch.detail: The plan is sold to another type of tenant.

confirmation_mismatch.title: Confirmation does not match
confirmation_mismatch.detail: Type the tenant slug exactly to confirm.

disabled.title: Subscriptions are switched off
disabled.detail: getproperty is free for operators (D-250); subscriptions are not used. Turn on platform.subscriptions.enabled to use them again.

not_found.title: No price in force
not_found.detail: The plan has no published price on that date.

not_sold.title: Plan not sold
not_sold.detail: The plan or add-on is not sold now, or not with this plan.

invalid_state.title: Price version not changeable
invalid_state.detail: Only a draft version from a date after the version in force can be published.

invalid_state.title: Not possible on this invoice
invalid_state.detail: The platform invoice or credit note is not in a state that allows this.

amount_exceeds_open.title: Amount too high
amount_exceeds_open.detail: The amount is higher than what is still open on the invoice.

same_approver.title: Second person required
same_approver.detail: Another platform user must approve a credit note (maker-checker).

not_platform_owned.title: Not a platform device
not_platform_owned.detail: Only devices owned by the platform (HaaS) go in the register.

tenant_mismatch.title: Device at another tenant
tenant_mismatch.detail: The device is assigned to another tenant.

invalid_transition.title: Invalid asset move
invalid_transition.detail: The asset cannot move to that state from its current state.

invalid_transition.title: Invalid order move
invalid_transition.detail: The order or survey cannot do this in its current state.

items_open.title: Items still open
items_open.detail: Mark every item done before completing the order.

assignee_invalid.title: Not a field engineer
assignee_invalid.detail: Assign the order to a platform user with the field engineer role.

invalid_state.title: Request cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The repair request is not in a state that allows this action.

in_warranty.title: Referred to the warranty
in_warranty.detail: This request is inside the developer warranty and was referred to them; it cannot get a work order of the building.

decision_unavailable.title: Not for this organisation
decision_unavailable.detail: Who fixes and who pays is decided by landlords; buildings use the technician queue.

not_decided.title: Decide first
not_decided.detail: Choose who pays for this repair before settling it with the tenant.

nothing_to_settle.title: Nothing to settle
nothing_to_settle.detail: The receipts are already settled with the tenant.

invalid_state.title: Work order cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The work order is not in a state that allows this action.

photo_required.title: After photo required
photo_required.detail: Add at least one photo of the finished work before completing it.

invalid_state.title: Credential cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The credential is no longer active.

visitor_codes_disabled.title: Visitor codes are not available
visitor_codes_disabled.detail: The building does not let residents create visitor codes in the app. Ask the building office.

unit_occupied.title: No visitor code for this unit
unit_occupied.detail: The unit is occupied; a viewing door code is never issued for an occupied unit.

exists.title: Lock already registered
exists.detail: A lock with this vendor id or serial number is already registered.

published.title: Already published
published.detail: A published announcement keeps its text; publish a new one instead.

invalid_state.title: Parcel already handled
invalid_state.detail: The parcel was already picked up or returned.

pin_mismatch.title: Wrong pick-up PIN
pin_mismatch.detail: The PIN does not match this parcel.

unavailable.title: Facility unavailable
unavailable.detail: The facility is not open for booking.

quota_exceeded.title: Weekly quota reached
quota_exceeded.detail: Your unit has used its bookings of this facility for the week.

slot_taken.title: Slot already booked
slot_taken.detail: Someone booked this time already; choose another slot.

booking_invalid_state.title: Booking cannot change
booking_invalid_state.detail: The booking is not in a state that allows this action.

not_completable.title: Task cannot be completed here
not_completable.detail: This kind of task ({type}) is completed by Collective field engineers, not on the staff app.

tenant_controlled.title: Handled by the tenant
tenant_controlled.detail: This request is addressed to a tenant (the controller of its residents' data); that tenant handles it.

erasure_blocked.title: Account still in use
erasure_blocked.detail: The login still works for a tenant (membership or linked resident); that tenant must end it before the account can be erased.

invalid_state.title: e-Tax submission cannot change
invalid_state.detail: Only a rejected or failed submission can be sent again (now: {status}).

invalid_state.title: TM30 notification cannot change
invalid_state.detail: The TM30 notification is not in a state that allows this action (now: {status}).

data_missing.title: Passport data missing
data_missing.detail: Some foreign occupants lack the data the Immigration Bureau requires; complete their profiles first.

nothing_pending.title: Nothing to notify
nothing_pending.detail: The building has no pending TM30 notification.

not_due.title: Survey already answered
not_due.detail: You answered the satisfaction survey recently; it will be offered again later.

allowance_exceeded.title: Storage allowance reached
allowance_exceeded.detail: This optional file would put the account over its storage allowance. Remove files you no longer need or ask getproperty about more space; documents the law requires are always stored.

legal_hold.title: Document under legal hold
legal_hold.detail: This document must be kept by law until its retention date and cannot be deleted. It still counts to your storage; free space by deleting optional files or buy a storage package.

not_deletable.title: File cannot be deleted here
not_deletable.detail: Only optional uploads you no longer use (listing photos of closed listings, attachments) can be deleted to free space. Evidence, identity and system documents follow their retention rules.

not_restorable.title: File cannot be restored
not_restorable.detail: Only files you deleted to free space can be restored, and only before they are removed for good.

package_not_on_sale.title: Storage package not on sale
package_not_on_sale.detail: This storage package has no price yet or is no longer offered. Choose another package or delete files you no longer need.

package_pending.title: Purchase already waiting for payment
package_pending.detail: You already ordered this storage package; pay its invoice to activate it.

unit_claimed.title: Unit already registered
unit_claimed.detail: Another owner has already registered this unit number in this project. If it is yours, contact getproperty support to verify your ownership.

not_a_stub.title: Not a stub building
not_a_stub.detail: Only an external stub (a condo not on getproperty yet) can be claimed.

claimant_invalid.title: Cannot claim
claimant_invalid.detail: The owner must be a condo juristic tenant and the operator a condo juristic or PM company tenant.

duplicate_unit.title: Unit already listed
duplicate_unit.detail: This unit already has a listing that is live or waiting for review. Edit that one instead.

invalid_state.title: Not possible now
invalid_state.detail: The listing is not in a state that allows this action.

incomplete.title: Listing incomplete
incomplete.detail: Add what is missing before you submit the listing.

photo_invalid.title: Photo not usable
photo_invalid.detail: Use a clean, uploaded listing photo of this tenant.

report_duplicate.title: Already reported
report_duplicate.detail: You have already reported this listing. Our team is looking at it.

verification_pending.title: Verification in progress
verification_pending.detail: This unit already has a verification waiting for review.

verification_invalid_state.title: Already decided
verification_invalid_state.detail: This verification has already been decided.

checker_same_user.title: Second reviewer needed
checker_same_user.detail: Another platform user must confirm this approval.

consent_required.title: Consent needed
consent_required.detail: Agree to the owner using your details to answer your enquiry, then send again.

enquiry_limit.title: Too many enquiries today
enquiry_limit.detail: You have started many enquiries today. Please try again tomorrow, or continue in an enquiry you already have.

lead_invalid_state.title: Not possible now
lead_invalid_state.detail: This enquiry is closed or not in a state that allows this action.

viewing_slot_unavailable.title: Time not available
viewing_slot_unavailable.detail: Pick one of the viewing times the owner offers.

viewing_slot_taken.title: Time just taken
viewing_slot_taken.detail: Someone else booked this time a moment ago. Please pick another time.

viewing_exists.title: Viewing already booked
viewing_exists.detail: You already have a viewing of this place. Change its time instead of booking another.

viewing_invalid_state.title: Not possible now
viewing_invalid_state.detail: This viewing is not in a state that allows this action.

lease_exists.title: Lease already drafted
lease_exists.detail: A lease was already drafted from this enquiry. Open it from Leases.

bank_account_in_message.title: Bank account numbers cannot be sent in messages
bank_account_in_message.detail: To stop rental scams, account numbers are not allowed in listing chats; bookings and move-in money are paid through getproperty only. Remove the number and send again.

request_open.title: Request already open
request_open.detail: You already asked for a rent payment certificate; ask again once your landlord has answered.

invalid_state.title: Already answered
invalid_state.detail: This certificate request was already issued or declined.

voided.title: Already voided
voided.detail: This quotation or receipt was voided before.

link_invalid.title: Link not found
link_invalid.detail: This LINE link is not valid. Send a message to the LINE account again for a new one.

link_expired.title: Link expired
link_expired.detail: This LINE link has expired. Send a message to the LINE account again for a new one.

link_used.title: Link already used
link_used.detail: This LINE link was already used.

line_user_taken.title: Linked to someone else
line_user_taken.detail: This LINE account is already linked to another getproperty user.

addon_terms_required.title: Accept the fees first
addon_terms_required.detail: Connecting your own LINE OA has a setup fee and a monthly fee; confirm the prices before connecting.

in_the_past.title: Effective date in the past
in_the_past.detail: The effective date must be today or later

invalid_state.title: Rate already handled
invalid_state.detail: This rate was already published or withdrawn

same_checker.title: Another user must publish
same_checker.detail: The rate must be published by a different platform user than the one who entered it

already_verified.title: Identity already verified
already_verified.detail: This account is already verified; there is nothing more to do.

unavailable.title: Online identity verification is not available yet
unavailable.detail: Identity verification is not open yet. Please try again later.

empty.title: No rent record yet
empty.detail: There is no confirmed month to share yet: months paid through getproperty appear here once their due date has passed.

slug_taken.title: This guide already exists
slug_taken.detail: A guide with this slug and language exists; edit it instead.

same_reviewer.title: Another user must publish
same_reviewer.detail: The guide must be reviewed and published by a different platform user than the last one who edited it.

invalid_state.title: Mandate cannot change now
invalid_state.detail: This mandate is not in a state that allows this action (for example it was already accepted, ended or revoked).

exclusive_conflict.title: An exclusive mandate is in the way
exclusive_conflict.detail: The unit has an exclusive mandate, or other agencies already hold mandates so it cannot be made exclusive. End the other mandate first.

agency_required.title: Not an estate agency
agency_required.detail: Mandates and co-broke agreements are made with tenants of type agency only.

invalid_state.title: Co-broke agreement cannot change now
invalid_state.detail: This co-broke agreement is not in a state that allows this action, or you are not the agency that may take it.

template_invalid.title: Contract text not allowed
template_invalid.detail: The contract text has HTML or template syntax that is not allowed (scripts, styles, links, unescaped values, partials or unknown helpers).

unknown_variable.title: Unknown variable
unknown_variable.detail: The text or the values use a variable this contract kind does not have. Use only the variables listed for the kind.

invalid_state.title: Contract cannot change now
invalid_state.detail: This contract is not in a state that allows this action (for example it was already sent, signed or cancelled).

not_signer.title: Not a signer
not_signer.detail: You are not a signer of this contract, or your side has already signed.

already_signed.title: Already signed
already_signed.detail: Every signature this contract needs from you is already recorded.

changed.title: Contract changed
changed.detail: The contract you read is not the current one. Open it again and sign the version shown.

signature_invalid.title: Signature not valid
signature_invalid.detail: The signature must be a PNG image of at most 200 KB.

offer_exists.title: A renewal offer is open
offer_exists.detail: This lease already has an open renewal offer. Withdraw it before making a new one.

invalid_state.title: Renewal offer cannot change now
invalid_state.detail: This renewal offer was already answered, withdrawn or has expired, or the lease can no longer be renewed.

self_unavailable.title: Self-viewing is not available
self_unavailable.detail: This unit does not offer self-viewing. Book a viewing with the owner or staff instead.

unit_occupied.title: The unit is occupied
unit_occupied.detail: Self-viewing is only for vacant units.

requirements_missing.title: Verify yourself first
requirements_missing.detail: Self-viewing needs a verified identity, a verified phone and the accepted visitor terms.

terms_outdated.title: The visitor terms changed
terms_outdated.detail: Read and accept the latest visitor terms before booking.

access_overlap.title: You already have a self-viewing then
access_overlap.detail: Another self-viewing of yours overlaps this time. Pick another time.

code_not_available.title: The door code is not available
code_not_available.detail: The door code is shown only during your viewing window.

access_open_elsewhere.title: You are still in another unit
access_open_elsewhere.detail: Confirm you have left the unit you are viewing before opening the next code.

access_invalid_state.title: Not possible right now
access_invalid_state.detail: This viewing access is in a state that does not allow this.

unavailable.title: Facebook Pages are not available
unavailable.detail: Automatic posts on Facebook Pages are not available yet; use the share kit instead.

page_refused.title: Facebook refused this Page
page_refused.detail: Facebook did not accept this Page's token. Check the Page id and the Page access token and try again.

not_on_sale.title: This boost is not on sale
not_on_sale.detail: getproperty has not set a price for this boost yet. Try again later.

pending.title: Already waiting for payment
pending.detail: The same boost of this listing or building is waiting for its invoice to be paid.

already_active.title: A free boost is already running
already_active.detail: This building already has its free boost in force; a new one can start when it ends.

listing_not_public.title: The listing is not public
listing_not_public.detail: Only a published listing can be boosted or get a media service.

not_on_sale.title: This service is not on sale
not_on_sale.detail: getproperty has not set a price for this service yet.

order_open.title: An order is already open
order_open.detail: This unit already has an open order for the same service.

invalid_state.title: Not possible right now
invalid_state.detail: This order is in a state that does not allow this.

not_invoiced.title: Not invoiced yet
not_invoiced.detail: This fee is not on a platform invoice yet; it can be disputed once invoiced.

already_disputed.title: Already disputed
already_disputed.detail: A credit note for this fee is waiting for approval or was issued.

invalid_state.title: This invitation cannot be used now
invalid_state.detail: The invitation was already used, declined or has expired.

landlord_required.title: A landlord account is needed
landlord_required.detail: Sign up as a landlord (free) to add the unit you bought and list it for rent.

invalid_state.title: Not possible in this state
invalid_state.detail: The employer agreement has ended, or the lease is no longer open.

building_mismatch.title: Different building
building_mismatch.detail: The lease is in a building the employer agreement does not cover.

consent_required.title: Consent needed
consent_required.detail: Turn on “Help finding my next home” in your privacy settings to see places in your destination.

invalid_state.title: This offer is closed
invalid_state.detail: The relocation offer was dismissed, withdrawn or has closed.

consent_required.title: Recommendations are off
consent_required.detail: Turn on “Recommended places” first, then set the areas and budget you are interested in.

consent_outdated.title: The consent text changed
consent_outdated.detail: Please read the latest text and confirm again.

sponsored_disabled.title: Sponsored messages are not available yet
sponsored_disabled.detail: Sponsored recommendations through getproperty’s LINE OA are not switched on yet.

not_on_sale.title: Not on sale yet
not_on_sale.detail: No price per recipient has been set for this service yet.

listing_not_public.title: Listing not published
listing_not_public.detail: A campaign can only carry your own listings that are published on getproperty.

below_minimum.title: Below the minimum
below_minimum.detail: This segment has fewer recipients than the minimum of {minimum}. Try more areas or a wider budget.

invalid_state.title: Not possible in this campaign state
invalid_state.detail: The campaign was already scheduled, sent, cancelled or rejected.
